steps.what: Read the posted exam card before this sitting.
Compile examinations from the posted exam card.
Administer examinations in the clinical teaching room.
Mark closed items from the posted answer key.
Grade examinations and assign others the open items.

tasks.design: The exam office posts an exam card in {DOCS} before the sitting: course code, sitting date, room, closed-item ids and answer-key version. The health specialties teacher reads that card, compiles the examination paper and administers the sitting in the room. Marking closed items from that key is its own step in the {LMS}, with its own effort, write authority and gate, confirmed while the teacher grades open items and assigns others. Nothing sends a record, raises an alert, or fills a sheet.
tasks.previous_blocker: Closed items were marked by hand because the answer key lived in the teacher's notes, not on a line the learning system could match.
tasks.enabler_now: The exam office can post the key version on the exam card, and the learning system can match closed items to that key without a model.
tasks.still_hard: Open items, practical sittings and the exam result stay with the examiner.
tasks.human_edge: Only the appointed examiner sets the result. A key match is not a grade decision, and it does not detect cheating.
tasks.altitude: The week still includes compiling the paper, giving the exam and grading open items. Less of it is hunting the answer key or ticking closed items by hand.

reach.task: Post the exam card before the sitting
reach.learn: Which sittings have a blank answer-key line or no closed items

reach.task: Mark the open items the teacher assigns
reach.learn: Which items the examiner still grades themselves

evidence.claim: Ans auto-marks closed questions and can split open ones among markers. Its description lists no model grade. This design marks only closed items from a posted key and does not split open items.

Annex III covers evaluating learning outcomes and detecting cheating. Emotion inference in education is banned. Matching a posted key is not a model grade, and this design does not detect cheating or infer emotion.
A grade set solely by a model is likely an article 22 decision. Examiners appointed by the examination board set the result. The teacher sets this exam result.
Utrecht forbids automated grading on its generative pilot. This design does not let a model set the exam result.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: one sitting, one health specialties teacher. They compile the paper, administer the sitting and set the result. They do not sanction fraud, proctor by camera or detect cheating. The in-person prior of 40.6 sits in administering the sitting, share 41. The documents prior of 39.2 sits in compiling the paper, share 26, and in grading open items, share 12. The screen prior of 5.5, the mail prior of 5.2 and the sheet prior of 9.4 sit in the card read, share 12, and in the closed-item mark, share 9. Those scraps are not a separate saving.

Exam-card contract, produced by the exam office before the sitting, outside this task: course code, sitting date, room, closed-item ids and answer-key version. The teacher reads that card in {DOCS}, which is why the read drops to 75 percent. If the key line is blank, or the sitting is practical or oral with no closed items, the read is not shorter and closed items are marked by hand. The office's posting time is the office's, not the teacher's. Capture sits in the read.

Marking closed items from the posted key is the only machine action. It has its own step, share 9, write authority and a gate. It does not set the result. The teacher confirms that closed-mark list while grading open items, which stays at 100 percent. Nothing sends a record, raises an alert, or fills a sheet. The learning system running the match is not the teacher's time. Upkeep of 0.3 hours per 100 is rechecking a stale key line.
unknowns: Whether the exam office can post the answer-key version before every sitting.
What share of sittings are practical or oral and have no closed items.
Whether this faculty's works council treats the closed-mark list as a staff-performance record.
research_questions: On what share of sittings is the answer-key line blank or the exam practical?

already_counted.description: Reading the exam card once it is open.
Compiling the paper, giving the exam and grading open items.

incremental.description: Recheck a stale answer-key line before the sitting. Open-item grading stays with the teacher.

approvals.approved_version: Closed-mark list for this sitting, confirmed while open items are graded.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: About a third of sittings are practical or have a blank answer-key line, so the read is not shorter and closed items are marked by hand. The paper, the room and the open-item grade stay full length.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain attendance, grades and other records

steps.what: Read the posted register card before this session.
Notice which student is present in the teaching room.
Maintain student attendance records, grades and other required records.
Copy the confirmed record into the student file.

tasks.design: The programme office posts a register card in {DOCS}: course code, session date and enrolled names. The teacher notices who is present and writes attendance, grades and the other required records in the {LMS}. Copying that confirmed line into the student records store is its own step on {OTHER}, with its own effort, write authority and gate on the line the teacher wrote. Nothing raises an alert or fills a sheet, and the copy does not run when the grade line is blank.
tasks.previous_blocker: The course record and the student file were two entries of the same line, so the teacher typed it twice.
tasks.enabler_now: Once the teacher has written the line, a deterministic copy can place that same line in the student records store.
tasks.still_hard: Noticing who is in the room, and deciding the grade, stay with the teacher.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher decides the grade and writes the course record. The copy does not decide either.
tasks.altitude: The week still includes taking attendance and writing the course record. Less of it is typing the same line into the student file.

reach.task: Post the register card before the session
reach.learn: Which sessions have a blank enrolled-names line

reach.task: Accept one confirmed line into the student file
reach.learn: Whether a second manual entry is still required after the copy

evidence.claim: Radboud requires a grade kept in Brightspace to be published in OSIRIS as well, which is a second entry. This design copies only the attendance and grade line the teacher already wrote. It is not a measured time saving.
The appointed examiner sets the result. Copying a line the teacher already wrote is not a grade set solely by a model.
Works-council consent applies to systems that can monitor staff, such as a per-examiner marking dashboard. This design does not build one.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: one session, one health specialties teacher. They notice who is present and write the course record. They do not decide a fraud sanction. The in-person prior of 24.1 sits in noticing who is present, share 24. The documents prior of 38.1 and the mail prior of 4.5 sit in writing the course record, share 43. The screen prior of 19.2 sits in the register-card read, share 19. The sheet prior of 14.0 sits in the student-file copy, share 14. Those scraps are not a separate saving.

Register-card contract, produced by the programme office before the session, outside this task: course code, session date and enrolled names. No grade is on the card. The teacher reads it in {DOCS}, which is why the read drops to 75 percent. If the enrolled-names line is blank, the read is not shorter and the teacher types the second entry by hand. The office's posting time is the office's. Capture sits in the read.

The only machine action is the copy of the confirmed line into the student records store. It has its own step, share 14, write authority and a gate. The gate is the course record the teacher already wrote, so the copy does not run when the grade line is blank. Nothing raises an alert or fills a sheet. There is no per-examiner marking dashboard, so works-council consent for staff monitoring is not triggered by this copy. The store running is not the teacher's time. Upkeep of 0.3 hours per 100 is rechecking a rejected copy.
unknowns: Whether the student records store can take a copy of one confirmed line without a second manual entry.
Whether attendance is taken by the teacher or by a colleague in the room.
Whether this faculty's works council treats the student-file copy as staff monitoring.
research_questions: On what share of sessions is the grade line still blank when the course record is filed?

already_counted.description: Reading the register card once it is open.
Noticing who is present and writing the course record.

incremental.description: Recheck a copy the student records store rejected. The grade stays the teacher's.

approvals.approved_version: Attendance and grade line for this session, as the teacher wrote it on the course record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: About a third of sessions have a blank register line or a blank grade line, so the read is not shorter and the copy does not run. Taking attendance and writing the course record stay full length.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the posted clinical discussion card before this class.
Initiate, facilitate and moderate classroom discussions on the clinical case.

tasks.design: The programme office, or the teacher in an earlier planning task, posts a discussion card in {DOCS}: topic, case and what the students were asked to read. The teacher reads it, then initiates, facilitates and moderates the classroom discussion in the room. Nothing sends a record, raises an alert, or fills a sheet.
tasks.previous_blocker: The topic lived in the teacher's notes, so the first minutes went to finding it, but the discussion itself was always live.
tasks.enabler_now: A posted topic card can be read before class. It does not speak in the room.
tasks.still_hard: Starting, holding and closing the discussion stay with the teacher and the students.
tasks.human_edge: Students answer a person in the room. A card does not moderate, and the step does not infer emotion.
tasks.altitude: The week still includes leading the discussion. Less of it is hunting the topic before class.

reach.task: Post the discussion card before the session
reach.learn: Which sessions have no posted topic or case

evidence.claim: Emotion inference in education is banned. Leading the discussion does not infer emotion from the students.
A classroom discussion is the teacher's live work with the students. A posted topic card does not replace it.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: one session, one health specialties teacher, in the room with the students. They lead the discussion. They do not score emotion or record a grade in this task. The in-person prior of 89.6 sits in the discussion, share 92. The documents prior of 7.9, the screen prior of 1.0, the mail prior of 1.4 and the sheet prior of 0.1 sit inside that discussion and the card read, share 8. Those scraps are not a separate saving.

Discussion-card contract, produced by the programme office, or by the teacher in an earlier planning task, before the session: topic, case and what the students were asked to read. The teacher reads it in {DOCS}, which is why the read drops to 75 percent. If the card is blank the teacher states the topic and the read is not shorter. Capture sits in the read. There is no machine step, no send, no alert, no sheet fill, and no step at zero remaining time.
The classroom discussion is unchanged, so that step stays at 100 percent. Upkeep of 0.2 hours per 100 is rechecking a stale discussion card. No system runs during the discussion.
unknowns: Whether the programme office or the teacher posts the discussion card today.
Whether a blank card is usual for clinical case sessions.
research_questions: On what share of sessions is the discussion card blank?

already_counted.description: Reading the discussion card once it is open.

incremental.description: Recheck a stale discussion card before class. The discussion stays in the room.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: About a third of sessions have a blank discussion card, so the read is not shorter. The classroom discussion stays full length.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan, evaluate and revise the course

steps.what: Read the posted programme card before this revision.
Plan and evaluate curricula against the posted programme card.
Write proposed course content and course materials.

loop.input: The posted programme card: programme code, learning outcomes, and the clinical claims that must stay.
loop.output: Proposed course materials with each clinical claim beside a quoted source.
loop.check: Each clinical claim quotes a source the teacher accepts, and each learning outcome matches the posted card. A claim with no quote is rejected.
loop.stop: After two failed checks the teacher writes the passage. The proposal is not stored.
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed template cannot tell whether a clinical claim matches a source it has not read.

steps.what: Revise course content, course materials and methods of instruction.

tasks.design: The programme office posts a programme card in {DOCS}: programme code, learning outcomes and the clinical claims that must stay. Planning and evaluating the curricula stays with the teacher. Writing proposed course content and course materials is its own step, with its own effort, draft authority and gate, and it stops when a clinical claim has no quoted source. The teacher then revises and signs the materials and the methods of instruction. Nothing sends the revision, raises an alert, or fills a sheet.
tasks.previous_blocker: Course materials were written from a blank page, and a template could not tell whether a clinical claim matched a source.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded draft can propose the passage and reject a claim that has no quote. The teacher still signs.
tasks.still_hard: Judging whether the course still teaches the right clinical method, and accepting each claim, stay with the teacher.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher rejects a clinical claim they do not accept, even when a quote is attached. The draft does not set a grade.
tasks.altitude: The week still includes planning, evaluating and signing the course. Less of it is writing a first passage from a blank page.

reach.task: Post the programme card before the revision
reach.learn: Which clinical claims they will list, and which they will not

reach.task: Keep the learning outcomes on the programme card
reach.learn: Which outcomes must stay word for word in the signed revision

evidence.claim: Drafting course materials is not covered by the duties on AI grading and proctoring. The teacher still signs the revision, and the draft does not set a grade.
Annex III covers evaluating learning outcomes and detecting cheating. A grade set solely by a model is likely an article 22 decision. This draft does not set a grade and does not detect cheating.
Works-council consent applies to systems able to monitor staff, such as a per-examiner marking dashboard. A materials proposal the teacher signs is not that dashboard.
A clinical teaching method can harm a patient if a claim is wrong. The teacher rejects a claim that has no source they accept.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: one revision cycle, one health specialties teacher. They plan and evaluate the curricula, and they sign the course revision. They do not set a grade, detect cheating or write a grant in this task. The gather prior of 17.8 rounds to the programme-card read, share 18. The documents prior of 41.3 and the in-person prior of 43.7, plus the mail prior of 6.4, the sheet prior of 5.3 and the screen prior of 3.3, sit inside planning and evaluating, share 36, and revising, share 38. The proposal, share 8, is the first-passage drafting the loop takes. Those scraps are not a separate saving.

Programme-card contract, produced by the programme office before the revision, outside this task: programme code, learning outcomes and the clinical claims that must stay. The teacher reads it in {DOCS}, which is why the read drops to 75 percent. If the card is blank, no proposal is written, the read is not shorter, and the teacher revises from a blank page. The office's posting time is the office's. Capture sits in the read.

Writing the proposed materials is the only machine action. It has its own step, share 8, draft authority and a gate. The check rejects a clinical claim with no quoted source, and it checks that each learning outcome matches the posted card. It does not check only an id. The revise step stays at 85 percent because the teacher edits a proposal rather than writing from a blank page, and that remaining time is the clinical check. Planning and evaluating stay at 100 percent. Nothing sends the revision, raises an alert, or fills a sheet. The teacher stores the signed revision as their own write. Upkeep of 0.3 hours per 100 is rechecking a stale programme card. The model running is not the teacher's time.
unknowns: Which clinical claims the programme office is willing to list on the card.
Whether the works council treats a materials proposal as staff monitoring. This design does not monitor the teacher.
research_questions: On what share of revisions does a clinical claim lack a source the teacher accepts?

already_counted.description: Reading the programme card once it is open.
Planning and evaluating the curricula, and revising the signed course text.

incremental.description: Recheck a stale programme card before the revision. The clinical check stays in the revise step.

approvals.approved_version: Proposed course materials for this revision, after the teacher accepts or rewrites each clinical claim.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: About a third of revisions have a blank programme card, so the read is not shorter, no proposal is written, and the revision is done from a blank page. Planning and evaluating the curricula stay full length.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The week is still teaching: compiling and giving the exam, marking open items, taking attendance and writing the record, leading the discussion, and revising the course. Less of it is hunting a posted card or retyping a line already written.
reach: The exam office posts the answer-key version on the exam card before the sitting.
The programme office posts the register card, the discussion card and the programme card.
The teaching assistant marks open items only after the teacher assigns them.
skills_to_grow: Refuse a model that sets a grade, detects cheating, or infers emotion
The examiner still sets the result
Reject a clinical claim that has no source the teacher accepts
role.ambitious_version: The cards are already posted and a confirmed line is copied. The teacher still teaches.
